notes: CS applicationRequirements batch2c for Fall 2027 (as_of 2026-10-27 Asia/Hong_Kong).
Official admissions pages preferred over curriculum/catalogue pages supplied as seed URLs.
FLAG: princeton-cs — NO master's applications for Fall 2027 (MSE suspended).
FLAG: uci-cs covers dual research MS + professional MCS with different deadlines.
Never invent; unknown when researched but unset; optional ≠ waived.

items.program: MSE in Computer and Information Science (CIS)

gre.detail: Penn Engineering: GRE optional for current master's cycle (Fall 2027 open Sep 15, 2026–Feb 1, 2027). Omitting does not hurt; valid scores encouraged if available. Institution code 2888; scores valid 5 years; official scores by deadline.

gmat.detail: Pure CIS MSE; GMAT not listed on Penn Engineering How to Apply.

toefl.detail: International / non-US citizen/PR whose native language is not English must submit TOEFL iBT (code 2888), IELTS, or DET. No hard minimum for admission; recommended TOEFL 5.0 (or 100 legacy 0–120). At-home TOEFL accepted. Scores valid 2 years; exam by deadline.

ielts.detail: IELTS accepted; recommended 7.5. Send electronically to “University of Pennsylvania School of Engineering and Applied Science.” At-home IELTS accepted.

english.waiver: Waived if by matriculation applicant: graduates from a U.S. program; attends school in a country where English is official language; or graduates from an institution where English is the medium of instruction (indicated on unofficial transcript). Waiver processed after submit (3–5 business days).

gpa.detail: No admission minimum GPA stated on Penn Engineering How to Apply. CIS MSE expects strong undergrad math/CS preparation (OS, PL, DS, discrete math, linear algebra, algorithms/theory).

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Two letters for master's (three only for CIS Ph.D. / BE Ph.D. Medical Physics). Include one from a faculty member familiar with scholarly abilities. Submitted via application email link.

statementOfPurpose.detail: Personal statement ≤2 pages answering: interest in program; candidacy; benefit; contribution to Penn Engineering community; reasons for success; post-completion plans.

resume.detail: Professional resume covering job skills, depth of professional experience, leadership.

transcripts.detail: Unofficial transcript from each university/college with course credit; English with grade key; name, institution, courses, credit hours, grades. Official transcripts only if admitted and enroll.

interview.detail: Interview not mentioned on Penn Engineering How to Apply.

applicationFee.waivers: Auto-waived if US citizen/PR with proven low-income; Penn or U.S. military affiliation; or eligible US partner-institution Accelerated Master’s applicant.

other: Distinct from MCIT (conversion); non-CS undergrads directed toward MCIT/MAS-CS routes.
Fall 2027 master's: early CIS deadline Nov 1, 2026 11:59pm EST; regular Feb 1, 2027; decisions by Apr 1.
DET accepted (recommended 135).
applicationRequirements.advice: Apply via Penn Engineering Grad Admissions (not catalog curriculum page). Early Nov 1 for CIS if seeking early review. GRE optional≠waived. Confirm Fall 2027 fee/waiver categories on live how-to-apply.

gre.detail: Princeton Graduate School Computer Science field page: GRE General Test — Not Accepted (AY 2026–2027).

gmat.detail: Pure CS; GMAT not part of CS graduate admissions materials.

toefl.detail: MSE English policy (still posted): applicants whose primary language is not English and without complete undergrad education in English must submit TOEFL or IELTS. MSE requires TOEFL speaking ≥28 legacy / 6 new scale. Ph.D. also accepts DET. Exemptions: primary language English; undergrad entirely in English (degree before enrollment); or ≥2 years full-time graduate study entirely in English.

ielts.detail: IELTS accepted for MSE; speaking subsection equivalent 8 (per department MSE English requirement). Same exemption rules as TOEFL.

english.waiver: Exemptions per Grad School/department rules above; department does not control/approve exemptions—contact gsadmit@princeton.edu.

gpa.detail: No minimum GPA stated on CS admissions-requirements or Grad School CS field page.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Princeton Graduate School CS FAQ/admissions materials require three letters for CS graduate applications (Ph.D. path still open). MSE applications not accepted Fall 2027.

statementOfPurpose.detail: Academic Statement of Purpose required for Princeton graduate applications (≤1000 words per Grad School guidance). Writing sample/policy memo not required for CS.

resume.detail: Résumé/CV required per Princeton Graduate School application materials.

transcripts.detail: Upload transcripts with online application; do not mail to department. Incomplete applications disadvantaged.

interview.detail: Interview not stated on CS admissions-requirements page.

applicationFee.waivers: Fee waiver requests for financial hardship, qualifying programs, or recruiting-event codes via Grad School Application Fee Waiver Request.
applicationFee.detail: $90 per Grad School Computer Science field page (AY 2026–2027).

other: FLAG: Computer Science will NOT accept master's (MSE) applications for Fall 2027 admission (resource uncertainty). Ph.D. remains open (deadline Dec 15, 2026).
When open, all admits start MSE thesis track; may switch to M.Eng. non-thesis in spring Y1; funded via TA typically.
Fall admission only; no evening/weekend/summer courses.
applicationRequirements.advice: NO EXTERNAL MS for Fall 2027. Do not apply to MSE this cycle. Revisit later or consider Ph.D. only if research-bound. Requirements above are from still-posted official pages for when MS reopens / Ph.D. parallel materials.
sources: Princeton Grad School Computer Science field (AY 2026–2027)

gre.detail: CS Admissions: GRE is NOT required. FAQ: GRE scores are not required by the CS Admissions Committee.

gmat.detail: Pure CS MS; GMAT not listed among CS application materials.

toefl.detail: Intl applicants whose native language is not English must demonstrate proficiency by deadline. University OGSPS minimums: TOEFL iBT total 80 (W18/S18/L14/R19) for exams before Jan 21, 2026; after that date overall 4.0 with section floors W4.0/S3.5/L3.5/R4.0. CS recommends competitive TOEFL 100 with no subscale <22 (legacy) or no subscale <4.5 (new scale). Code 1631 dept 78. Self-report + official ETS.

ielts.detail: University IELTS Academic minimum overall 6.5 (R6.5/L6.0/S6.0/W5.5). CS recommends overall ≥7.5 with no band <7.0 for competitiveness.

english.waiver: Grad School may waive TOEFL/IELTS (not TA speaking) if baccalaureate/graduate/professional degree within 36 months before admission from English-primary-instruction school in English native/official language country. CS notes submitting scores still helps funding/GTA. Duolingo accepted for Grad School admission (CS expects overall ≥135, no sub-score <135) but not for GTA eligibility.

gpa.detail: Most successful applicants have major and cumulative GPAs above 3.5/4.0 (or 8.5/10 or 85/100). Institution quality considered. No absolute floor stated beyond holistic review; four-year bachelor’s (or equivalent) required before enrollment term.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: At least three letters submitted electronically by application deadline. Prefer academic/professional references able to comment on CS graduate readiness; research supervisor letter expected if applicable. MS: prefer junior/senior year professors.

statementOfPurpose.detail: Academic Statement of Purpose (plus Personal History Statement) listed in CS application steps and admissions criteria.
statementOfPurpose.alsoKnownAs: Academic Statement of Purpose (+ Personal History Statement)

resume.detail: Resume listed among CS Prepare your documents steps and admissions criteria.

transcripts.detail: Transcripts required; upload per Grad School rules. Also CS Supplementary Form (PDF).

interview.detail: Interview not mentioned on CS requirements/steps pages.

applicationFee.waivers: Domestic hardship and listed recruitment-program waivers per Purdue OGSPS How to Apply; currently enrolled Purdue students/alumni often fee-exempt.
applicationFee.detail: Purdue graduate application fee $60 domestic / $75 international (USD); one fee covers up to two campus/major selections. amountUsd records international rate.

other: Fall 2027 CS deadline Dec 1, 2026; Spring 2027 Oct 1, 2026.
CS Supplementary Form + Academic SoP + Personal History Statement required.
Applicants from another CS grad program normally complete ≥1 year there; if master's, normally complete that degree before Purdue registration.
applicationRequirements.advice: Curriculum page is not the admissions checklist—use CS graduate/admission/*. GRE not required ≠ waived. Aim CS-competitive English scores if seeking GTA.

gre.detail: MCS program page: GRE recommended, but not required. CS Graduate Program Application: applicants may optionally submit GRE general (not required). ETS code 6609. Subject GRE not required.

gmat.detail: Pure CS MCS; GMAT not listed.

toefl.detail: Foreign nationals / non-native English speakers must show proficiency. CS app page: ≥90 iBT TOEFL or Home Edition (code 6609). Grad School: exams before Jan 21, 2026 min 90; on/after that date min 4.5. Alternatives: IELTS ≥7, Duolingo ≥115, U.S. degree, or post-secondary degree where official language of instruction is English (approved list).

ielts.detail: Academic IELTS minimum overall 7. Report to “Rice University Graduate Admissions.”

english.waiver: Proof of degree from accredited U.S. high school/college/university; or completion/expected completion of post-secondary degree from institution where official language of instruction is English (Grad School country/university lists).

gpa.detail: MCS admissions: 3.0+ GPA listed among what applicants should prepare.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: At least three letters via online application system (names/emails; recommenders upload).

statementOfPurpose.detail: Statement of Purpose required (PDF upload per CS Graduate Program Application).

transcripts.detail: Electronic transcripts from each college/university via application; official mailed transcripts required if offered admission.

interview.detail: Interview not listed on MCS or CS graduate application pages.

applicationFee.waivers: Waivers rarely granted; contact gradapp@rice.edu if potentially eligible. Ph.D. has no fee (not MCS).
applicationFee.detail: $85 for MCS/MDS (on-campus and online) via online application credit card.

other: On-campus MCS Fall 2027: early scholarship Feb 10, 2027; international deadline May 1, 2027; domestic Jul 1, 2027; rolling review continues.
Spring 2027 also offered (early Oct 1 / final Nov 1, 2026).
Non-thesis 30-hour professional degree; internship required; CPT after two full-time semesters for intl.
Distinct from Online MCS / MAI / MDS.
applicationRequirements.advice: Prefer CS Graduate Program Application page over marketing MCS page for fee/English/deadlines. GRE optional≠waived. Early Feb 10 for scholarship consideration.

gre.detail: CS Graduate Application Checklists: GRE not required for PhD or MS. MS FAQ: GRE scores are not required and not considered from MS applicants.

gmat.detail: Pure CS MS; GMAT not accepted/listed.

toefl.detail: TOEFL required unless exemption. University minima for admission consideration: TOEFL 90 (before Jan 21, 2026) or 4.5 (on/after). Institution code 4704. Scores within 24 months of deadline. Autumn 2027 earliest valid test date Sep 1, 2024 per Grad Admissions.

ielts.detail: IELTS Academic accepted as TOEFL substitute; university minimum 7. Deliver via IELTS Results Service to Stanford University Graduate. Within 24 months of deadline.

english.waiver: Not required if: U.S. citizen/PR; self-declared first language English; earned U.S. bachelor’s/master’s/doctoral (or intl equiv) from university where all instruction in English; or ≥2 consecutive years professional/educational experience in English in past 10 years.

gpa.detail: No minimum GPA on CS Master's Admissions or checklist. Bachelor’s (or equivalent) required; strong quantitative/analytical skills; CS bachelor’s not required.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Exactly three online letters (min=max). Prefer ≥2 academic. No Interfolio; no mailed/emailed/faxed letters.

statementOfPurpose.detail: SoP ≤2 pages single-spaced: reasons for applying, preparation, research interests, career plans, background aiding evaluation of aptitude/motivation.

resume.detail: Submit resume in online application; include publications. Also supplemental form for publications/website.

transcripts.detail: Upload unofficial transcripts/e-transcripts for all institutions attended ≥1 year full-time (incl. Stanford NDO). Do not mail official unless contacted.

interview.detail: Interview not listed on CS graduate application checklist or MS FAQ.

applicationFee.waivers: Stanford Grad Admissions fee waiver process (not detailed on CS checklist); see central Grad Admissions.
applicationFee.detail: $125 paid in online application by credit card.

other: Autumn 2027 only for MS (incl. HCP): applications open Sep 15, 2026; deadline Dec 8, 2026; decisions ~Mar 2027.
HCP (part-time) same admissions requirements; U.S. residence/employment constraints for eligibility.
MS admission is not a path guarantee to Stanford PhD.
applicationRequirements.advice: Degree-requirements page is curriculum only—use Admissions checklist + MS FAQ. GRE not considered. Confirm English exemption boxes carefully on Personal Background.

gre.detail: CS Apply page Optional Materials: GRE General Score may be submitted if it would strengthen the application; opting out does not adversely impact. Official scores if submitting.

gmat.detail: Pure CS; GMAT not listed on CS Apply page.

toefl.detail: International applicants must submit official TOEFL, IELTS, or DET unless exempt. Grad Admissions minima: TOEFL 79 (120 scale) or 4 (6-point scale) iBT. ETS code 6882. Institutional TOEFL ITP not accepted.

ielts.detail: IELTS Academic overall band 6.5 minimum. General Training not accepted. Electronic delivery to University of Texas at Austin.

english.waiver: Exempt if from a qualifying country list, or hold a bachelor’s from a U.S. or qualifying-country institution. Master’s-only from such institution does not waive. India is on UT qualifying-country list (bachelor’s from India can exempt).

gpa.detail: GPA ≥3.0 in upper-division courses and any graduate work completed required for eligibility. Competitive applicants typically have above-average GPA in CS coursework.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: At least three recommendation letters via MyStatus; supervisors or academic references. LOR deadline Dec 20 (application Dec 15).

statementOfPurpose.detail: SoP on intellectual motivation, goals, experiences; why graduate study and why UTCS. See department Statement of Purpose Guidelines.

resume.detail: Current CS Apply page lists required materials (Grad Office materials, ≥3 LORs, SoP) and optional GRE only; does not name resume/CV as required or optional. Older department checklist PDFs mentioned optional CV—left not_stated for current cycle.

transcripts.detail: Official transcripts from every senior college per UT Graduate Admissions how-to-apply (MyStatus upload / SPEEDE / Parchment, etc.). Bachelor’s from regionally accredited U.S. institution or comparable foreign degree.

interview.detail: Interview not mentioned on CS Apply page.

applicationFee.waivers: Need-based waivers for U.S. citizens/PR first-time graduate applicants only (documentation via gradfeewaiver@austin.utexas.edu). Not available for international citizens.
applicationFee.detail: UT Graduate Admissions: U.S. graduate $65 / International graduate $90 (non-MBA/MPA). amountUsd = international rate.

other: Application opens Oct 15; deadline Dec 15; LORs Dec 20; MS decisions ~Apr 1.
On-campus research MS (thesis or coursework) distinct from 100% online MSCS.
DET accepted university-wide (min 115) unless program prefers otherwise—CS Apply page silent on DET preference.
Must also complete UT Office of Graduate & Postdoctoral Studies required application materials.
applicationRequirements.advice: Research-degrees page is curriculum/overview—use /graduate/apply for checklist. Optional GRE ≠ waived. Confirm resume upload expectations in live portal.
sources: UTCS Apply (materials, GRE optional, GPA, LORs, SoP)
UT Graduate Admissions How to Apply (fee)

items.program: MS in Computer Science / Master of Computer Science (MCS)

gre.detail: MCS How to Apply: GRE Optional (not required). ICS research MS/PhD FAQ directs to Grad Division GRE list; third-party/portal summaries list Computer Science and Master of Computer Science as Not Required (verify live GRE portal—portal inactive at scrape). Neither route requires GRE; MCS explicitly allows optional submission.

gmat.detail: Pure CS routes; GMAT not listed.

toefl.detail: All graduate applicants must demonstrate English proficiency unless waived. Grad Division: TOEFL overall min 80 traditional / 4 new scale (Jan 2026+). Institution code 4859. No MyBest; Home Edition OK; ITP Plus/Essentials not accepted. Scores <2 years old.

ielts.detail: IELTS Academic overall min 7 with no module <6. Electronic from test center only; Online/Indicator OK; One Skill Retake not accepted.

english.waiver: Waived if undergraduate or master’s degree from institution where English was sole language of instruction per World Higher Education Database (WHED).

gpa.detail: UCI Grad Division / ICS FAQ: university minimum cumulative undergrad GPA 3.0/4.0. Holistic review if below.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: MCS: 3 letters (highly recommend ≥2 academic professors). ICS research FAQ: Letters of Recommendation required component; Grad Division lists LOR for most programs—use count 3 as MCS-stated and typical Grad Division default.

statementOfPurpose.detail: MCS: SoP on personal/academic/professional goals and fit. Research MS: SoP required (academic/research focus); Personal History Statement optional but highly recommended.
statementOfPurpose.alsoKnownAs: Statement of Purpose (+ Personal History Statement for MCS required; research optional/highly recommended)

resume.detail: MCS How to Apply checklist does not list resume/CV. Research FAQ lists supplemental materials generically—resume not explicitly required on pages reviewed.

transcripts.detail: Unofficial transcripts from all post-secondary institutions for review; official if admitted. MCS: all institutions after high school.

interview.detail: Interview not stated on MCS how-to-apply or ICS research admissions FAQ.

applicationFee.waivers: Fee waivers for certain U.S. citizens/PR per Grad Division; see Applying to UCI fee-waiver details.
applicationFee.detail: UCI Grad Division / MCS: $135 domestic (U.S. citizens & lawful PR) / $155 all other applicants. amountUsd = international rate.

other: TWO ROUTES: research MS (catalogue CS MS; Dec 15 deadline with PhD) vs professional MCS (intl Jan 15, 2027; domestic Feb 15, 2027).
MCS also requires Personal History Statement; recommends programming/algorithms/discrete+linear algebra + ≥1 year internship/professional experience.
Cannot apply to different degree levels (MS and PhD) in same program; separate apps/fees if applying to multiple ICS programs.
Fall quarter admission only for ICS.
applicationRequirements.advice: Pick research MS vs MCS before applying—deadlines and emphasis differ. Catalogue page is degree requirements only. Confirm live GRE portal status for research CS when portal is active.
sources: UCI Grad Division Applying to UCI

gre.detail: UCLA Grad Division 2026–2027 Computer Science admission requirements table: GRE: Not required. CS department page still carries Fall 2025–2026 optional-language for that prior cycle; for 2026–2027 cycle prefer Grad Division “Not required.” GMAT may not be substituted. Subject GRE not reviewed.

gmat.detail: CS Graduate Application Requirements: GMAT may not be substituted for the GRE.

toefl.detail: Intl / non-exempt: TOEFL iBT ≥87 (legacy) or overall ≥4.5 new scale (tests on/after Jan 21, 2026) per Grad English Requirements / CS page. UCLA code 4837; CS dept code 78. Valid within 2 years of application submit. Duolingo not accepted. FAQ also cites legacy subscores W25/S24/R21/L17.

ielts.detail: IELTS Academic overall ≥7.0. Send to major department and Division of Graduate Education.

english.waiver: Exempt if bachelor’s or higher from accredited U.S. university or from country where English is sole language of instruction per WHED; or completed two years full-time study at such institutions. Citizenship alone does not exempt.

gpa.detail: University cumulative GPA ≥3.0 for consideration. Dept reviews ≥3.0; most competitive ≥3.5 undergrad and ≥3.50 any graduate study; average admitted ~3.60.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: At least three letters via online application by Dec 15. MS: prefer professors from junior/senior years. (ESAP MS has special 2-letter CS-faculty rule.)

statementOfPurpose.detail: SOP 500-word limit in online application (prompts on Grad Division site). Also required Personal Statement 500-word limit. SOP serves as writing sample.

resume.detail: Resume/vitae not required; awards/distinctions/publications may be entered in online application sections instead.

transcripts.detail: Upload one official transcript per post-secondary institution in online application by Dec 15. Final official docs after offer. China/India specific degree-certificate rules on CS page. UCLA students: MyUCLA record OK.

interview.detail: Interview not listed among CS graduate application requirements.

applicationFee.waivers: Need-based and special-program waivers for eligible U.S. citizens/PR (and listed programs) per Grad Admissions FAQs; upload docs in Fee Waiver section. No exceptions beyond stated criteria.
applicationFee.detail: UCLA Grad Admissions FAQ: $135 U.S. citizens/PR; $155 all other applicants. amountUsd = international rate.

other: Fall only; deadline Dec 15 23:59 Pacific. Apply mid-Sep–Dec 15.
Apply to MS or PhD—not both. Applicants who already hold an MS in CS or closely related field not considered for MS.
MS funding: not eligible for departmental support; TA/GSR/reader not guaranteed; intl MS must show ≥~$65,000 first-year support for visa if admitted.
Program-requirements Grad page is degree requirements (thesis/capstone), not admissions checklist—use CS graduate-requirements.
applicationRequirements.advice: Use cs.ucla.edu/graduate-requirements/ + Grad Division 2026–2027 deptinfo for GRE. Do not rely on curriculum-only Grad program-requirements URL alone.
sources: UCLA Grad Division 2026–2027 CS Admission Requirements
UCLA Grad Program Requirements CS (degree plans)
